title: Give the council an annual fire safety statement
what: Give the council an annual fire safety statement for each building the business owns that has essential fire safety measures.

laws.title: Environmental Planning and Assessment (Development Certification and Fire Safety) Regulation 2021 (NSW)

sources.title: Environmental Planning and Assessment (Development Certification and Fire Safety) Regulation 2021 (NSW)

sources.quote: The owner of a building to which an essential fire safety measure applies must give the council an annual fire safety statement for the building
